svg.title: The Five Roles of Neo4j in Enterprise AI Agents
svg.desc: Neo4j plays five complementary roles for an agent: a knowledge layer for GraphRAG, an agent-brain layer for goals and decisions, a context layer for memory, a semantic layer bridging natural language to enterprise data, and a reasoning layer for real-time graph analytics.
svg.text: The Five Roles of Neo4j in Enterprise AI Agents
One graph stack, running on Bedrock and AgentCore, playing five complementary roles.
A native graph knowledge store: schema-enforced entity extraction and
multi-hop reasoning for agents running on Bedrock and AgentCore.
Agent Brain: Goal, State, and Decision Graph
Persistent cognitive architecture: a graph of goals, sub-goals, actions,
Context Layer: Session and Cross-Session Memory
A relational context graph in place of a flat memory store, so entities
resolve and connect instead of piling up as isolated chunks.
Semantic Layer: Natural Language to Enterprise Data
Neo4j as the semantic bridge between LLMs and enterprise systems such
as Amazon Redshift, Amazon S3, SAP, and Salesforce.
Reasoning and Data Layer: Real-Time Graph Analytics
Neo4j Graph Data Science algorithms, exposed as first-class agent tools
for centrality, community, and similarity questions.
Five roles, one graph: knowledge, memory, decisions, semantics, and analytics.
